usage: Discovery only. Fetch record_url and compare the complete scope, findings, limitations and review before claiming an idea was tested. No match means no matching documented record here, not proof that an idea is new.

records.title: LP2-33 and LP2-39: shared three-circle radii at native scale
records.question: Can the same ordered three radii centered on the horizontal dots meet at an in-page point on each page?
records.summary: Fresh dot measurements at three thresholds and exact rational bounds exclude shared ordered radii at native scale. Page-specific radii and rescaling remain outside the test.
